messages:
maria_support: Customer (AcmeSearch) hit a 413 when calling POST /v1/rerank. Error body is just 'input too large'. Customer expects guidance on whether the query or docs caused it and how to chunk. They sent a repro — can someone check what we return and if we can improve the message?

sam_engineer: can you paste the request payload (sanitized)? :eyes:

maria_support: pasted below, sanitized. note: docs array length ~750, many passages per doc.

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{
    "query": "What are the recommended configuration steps for deploying on prem with KMS?",
    "docs": ["<passage1>", "<passage2>", "... up to ~750 items ..."],
    "top_k": 50
  }'
```

ian_ml: thanks. Quick guess: our rerank rejects when total input tokens (query + all docs) exceed the model token budget (default 4096 for the current ranker model). But our error string is unhelpful. We also don't return the token counts, so support can't tell customers whether to trim query or docs.

clare_devops: logging shows a reject with code 413 at the tokenizer step. I can pull the pre-reject token counts for this request and confirm. (I flagged the request id 0a1b2c3d)

maria_support: customer wants: "Which field caused the overflow? how many tokens did I send? what's the max?" — they mentioned chunking options.

julie_product: we should return a structured error with: component (query|docs|combined), limit_tokens, input_tokens, and a human-friendly suggestion. Also add a short KB page that shows chunking patterns and a curl example for batching docs.

sam_engineer: agree. Proposed error body we could return (example):

```
HTTP/1.1 413 Payload Too Large
{
  "error": "input_too_large",
  "message": "Request exceeds token limit",
  "exceeded_component": "docs",
  "limit_tokens": 4096,
  "input_tokens": 9782,
  "suggestion": "Reduce number of docs or truncate passages. Consider sending top-k doc candidates and then call /v1/rerank with <= 250 docs or use our batch rerank helper. See: https://docs.redwood.ai/rerank/limits"
}
```

ian_ml: +1 but note: do NOT leak internal model names/precise budgets in public error. Use configurable per-customer quota values. Use wording like 'per-request token budget' and include numeric limit. Also include a short actionable tip: e.g., 'If you are sending N docs, try sending the top 250 candidates after initial embedding search'.

clare_devops: implementation notes: we can compute tokens at the edge prior to queuing and include token counts in logs and error payload. We'll need a small API change and a migration plan. Can we ship a temporary KB and support guideline first?

julie_product: yes. Action items: 1) Support KB draft (maria), 2) short-term error text improvement (sam) that includes plain text guidance but no structured fields, 3) engineering task to add structured error fields (sam + clare) with rollout plan, 4) SDK note to surface the message (devexp).

maria_support: I'll draft KB and reply to customer with repro steps and a workaround: run an embedding search to filter top-k docs to <=250, or paginate docs into multiple rerank calls and merge results client-side. I'll include example curl for chunking.

sam_engineer: I'll add a short patch to change the 413 body server-side to include a single-line hint for now: "Reason: request token budget exceeded (X tokens over limit). Try reducing docs or truncating passages; see https://docs.redwood.ai/rerank/limits" — then follow up with structured fields in a minor release.

deploy_bot: deploy queued: change-set #5487 (support-error-hint) -> staging :rocket:

maria_support: thanks all — I'll update customer with workaround and link to KB once drafted. Marking for follow-up in 48h. :thumbsup:
